newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint ends steady vs dlr at 188.57/62.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint ends steady vs dlr at 188.57/62.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed routine Tuesday trading steady against the dollar and firmly on the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level (bid), traders said.
The forint finished at 188.57/62 against the U.S. unit, unchanged from midday and compared with an opening of 188.52/57.

Traders said the afternoon session was quiet as the dollar/mark moved very little, summer holidays also reduced activity and movements of currencies other than the dollar/mark do not affect the forint.

"Other currencies like the sterling were in the focus lately, but due to the composition of the basket the forint remained unchanged," said Peter Piros of Europai Kereskedelmi Bank. "Also, there is virtually no opportunity for arbitrage".
(The NBH's floating intervention band is 4.5 percent wide. The forint floats against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.)
